# File Password Remover

> Local CLI/desktop/mobile tool that removes password protection from PDF,
> Office, ZIP and 7-Zip files after the correct password is supplied, and adds
> protection to PDF and ZIP files. No network
> code, no uploads, no password/dictionary attacks. Output is verified by
> re-reading it from disk before success is reported.

Full agent-facing usage guide (install, exact invocations, JSON schemas, exit
codes, refusal cases): /agents.md

## Core facts

- Never cracks, guesses, brute-forces, or bypasses a password. Wrong password
  → exit code 3, no output file, no retry loop exists to build around.
- No `--password VALUE` flag exists, on purpose (shell history / `ps`
  exposure). Use `--password-stdin`, `--password-fd N`, or `--password-file`.
- `--json` on every command gives structured, machine-parseable output.
- `fpr protect FILE --generate` adds a password (PDF and ZIP only) and returns
  it as `generated_password`. It is the only copy that will ever exist; store it
  before doing anything else. No in-place mode, one file per run.
- Success is reported only after the written file is re-opened from disk and
  its content invariants (page counts, content digests) are checked against
  the input — see the `verification` object in `remove --json` output.
- Not on PyPI yet: install with `pip install git+https://github.com/Jayanth-reflex/file-password-remover`.
- No iOS/Android app and no APK exist for this project — do not describe or
  link one if asked; point to the CLI under Termux/a-Shell instead.
